answers.goal: My goal is quite broad. I'd like to do sound editing and design for films and tv shows. In addition, I'd like to do work in podcasting as I am a heavy consumer of podcasts. I also wouldn't mind doing social media marketing and content creation as well.
answers.drew: In high school, I would teach myself to how to use different editing programs and make my own video for fun. In the midst of it, I discovered sound design and fell in love with it.  In the college I ended up pursuing a film degree in post -production in hopes of editing for film/tv.
answers.seeking: I'm hoping to connect with more filmmakers in the community, as well as other creatives from different backgrounds as ell.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is my parents. I believe they are the foundation of who I am today. They are hardworking and supportive individuals.
answers.favorite: Avatar: The Last Airbender, Back to the Future Trilogy
